summary: Iteration 20 — Portal dropdown testing (Header.jsx). Found TWO critical bugs. (1) FIXED myself: ReactDOM.createPortal was called WITHOUT the required second argument (document.body), causing 'Target container is not a DOM element' Uncaught runtime error the moment the profile dropdown was opened. Added `document.body` as 2nd arg. (2) STILL BROKEN — need main agent: With portal fix in place, portal rendering + z-index + hit-testing all pass (both overlay and dropdown are direct children of document.body, z=999998/999999, position:fixed, elementFromPoint at each menu-item center returns a child of the dropdown, dropdown-export & dropdown-logout are on top). HOWEVER every menu item onClick is silently swallowed. Clicking dropdown-profile does NOT navigate to /profil; dropdown-export triggers no /api/export/xlsx request nor download; dropdown-logout does NOT logout (token remains in localStorage, header-profile still visible). Overlay-click closes the menu correctly. Root cause: the outside-click useEffect (Header.jsx lines 75-82) registers a document mousedown listener that calls setMenuOpen(false) whenever the mousedown target is NOT inside menuRef. Because the dropdown is now portaled to document.body, menu-item buttons live OUTSIDE menuRef, so mousedown fires first, closes the menu and unmounts the portal before the button's click event fires — onClick never runs.

ui_bugs.issue: createPortal was missing the container argument -> Uncaught 'Target container is not a DOM element' every time the profile menu was opened. Fixed by adding document.body as 2nd arg to ReactDOM.createPortal.

Menu-item clicks (dropdown-profile, dropdown-users, dropdown-password, dropdown-export, dropdown-logout) do nothing. mousedown outside-click handler (lines 75-82) closes/unmounts the portal before the button click fires because menuRef doesn't contain the portaled children. Overlay click still closes the menu correctly.

integration_issues.issue: Anchor download never triggered — click event swallowed by outside-click closer.
logout() never called — token remains, user still authenticated.
nav('/profil') never fires; URL stays on /.

action_items: Remove or repair the mousedown outside-click useEffect in /app/frontend/src/components/Header.jsx (lines 75-82). Simplest fix: DELETE the useEffect entirely — the overlay div (inset:0) already handles outside-click closure. Alternatively, also whitelist clicks whose target is contained by the portaled overlay or dropdown, e.g.: `const dd = document.querySelector('[data-testid=header-profile-dropdown]'); const ov = document.querySelector('[data-testid=header-profile-overlay]'); if (menuRef.current.contains(e.target) || (dd && dd.contains(e.target)) || (ov && ov.contains(e.target))) return;` — but note the overlay onClick already closes on outside click, so removal is cleaner.

After fix, verify: dropdown-profile navigates to /profil, dropdown-users to /kullanicilar, dropdown-password to /profil, dropdown-export starts /api/export/xlsx download, dropdown-logout clears token and returns user to guest state.

rca of the issue: Two-part RCA. (A) Missing 2nd arg in ReactDOM.createPortal(<>...</>) — fixed by passing document.body. (B) Menu-item onClick never runs because Header.jsx has an outside-click useEffect that listens on document mousedown and closes the menu whenever the target is not inside menuRef. Since portaling moves the dropdown out of menuRef's subtree, every mousedown on a menu item is treated as an outside click, setMenuOpen(false) runs, React unmounts the portal, and the pending click event has no target to dispatch to. Reproduction: login as admin, click header-profile, click any menu item — nothing happens. Mitigation: delete the mousedown useEffect (the transparent overlay div already provides outside-click closure) OR extend the containment check to include the portaled overlay/dropdown DOM nodes.
